title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1762: Submit (2)

section.p: One dog and one man chatted away. Here, Su Yu felt completely relaxed and at ease. He did not have to be constantly wary and on the lookout for potential enemies. Here, he could sip tea, chat with the white dog, and listen to the distant voice of the reading book spirit. It was a very comfortable and peaceful environment.

It would probably feel even better if he could scratch the white dog behind his ears while sipping tea. But he didn’t dare to try since the white dog was too strong. However, Su Yu believed that the white dog probably wouldn’t mind it. After all, the white dog still viewed himself as a regular dog.
After a while, Su Yu took an item out. When the white dog saw it, he blinked and asked, “Is this that powerful heavenly desolate beast?”
“Yeah.” Su Yu explained, “I found it in Culture King’s Residence in the mansion. Take a look at it. Is the life force of the flesh still there?”
The white dog stood up and circled the figurine once. Suddenly, he barked. Right at that moment, Su Yu saw the vision of a roaring beast. A deafening roar rang out from the figurine.

Su Yu frowned, but the white dog appeared indifferent. After giving the figurine a sniff, the white dog said, “The life force remains, or to be precise, it is the grudge of the beast. It is both dead and alive. Are you thinking of resurrecting this fellow?”
Su Yu shook his head and said, “I prefer to have someone absorb it and inherit the inkstone dao.”

The white dog thought about it and said, “It’s very difficult. The grudge of this fellow remains. Only someone with a powerful will and body can suppress or even destroy this grudge to receive this inheritance. But someone like that has their own path. They might not be willing to transform into a heavenly desolate beast.”

Su Yu said, “That was the case in the past, but the present is different. This is an era with a decent number of top geniuses. However, there is no future for them. No matter how strong their will is, there is no way forward. In the past, people like them could pursue the physical body dao, a different dao, or open their own daos.

“The dao you believe to be original might not be original. You can happily open that dao only to find it connected to a different dao one day, a dao with an existing master. Both pursuing an existing dao or opening a new dao are too difficult in this era.”

Su Yu sighed and added, “The difficulty of opening a truly original dao is much higher. You need to leave the human section of the river and find a wild region to open your own dao. This marks the start of a new era. The glory of the primordial past and ancient past has officially ended. I can feel the decline. The poor cultivation methods and source qi quality of the current Human Realm are not the main reasons for our decline.”

Su Yu continued, “The Eternals of this era are just as talented. How can they not be talented to reach such a height under such a poor cultivation environment? But they can’t see the nature of the world. They don’t know that their path forward has been blocked by the humans of the primordial and ancient past.

“A senior of mine must have sensed something similar. I now know why his River of Time is so wide and long. He must have left the human section in search of his own dao. He must have discovered something without even understanding what it is. He only knows that walking a new path in the existing human section is a dead end.”
Su Yu was talking about Wan Tiansheng. Wan Tiansheng must have sensed something vague. Or perhaps he had explored the River of Time only to discover a suitable dao for him outside the human section.

But due to the distance of his dao, the difficulty for him to start the dao fusion or dao opening stage was incredibly great. He could only cultivate and accumulate his growth slowly. That was why he had yet to start opening or fusing with a dao.
In the past, Su Yu understood none of this. Things had changed. Perhaps during his next meeting with Wan Tiansheng, he could accompany Wan Tiansheng to the River of Time and take a look.
With a nod, the white dog asked, “Do you intend to get a human to inherit the heavenly desolate beast’s dao?”

“Yeah.” Su Yu said, “It is obvious the heavenly desolate beast is someone with a powerful body. I plan to have Great Qin King and Great Xia King try. Both can pursue this dao. The heavenly desolate beast’s dao is powerful enough for both of them. One can reach the Great Dao Realm while the other can still reach the Daofuse Realm. Of course, the one to become a Daofuse might need to consider switching dao again in the future. That is the only way for him to become a Great Dao expert.”
Despite the disadvantages, this would offer a far smoother path for them to reach the Daofuse Realm. Why? Because the two of them would be the only ones pursuing that dao.

Due to Su Yu’s previous promise to the hou race, he could also allow Skyeater to pursue this dao as well. One additional competitor was no big deal since this dao was wide enough to accommodate them all.

In truth, Su Yu had a feeling that having more people pursuing the same dao would not bring any disadvantages to the existing master of the dao. Rather, the master would grow stronger the more people cultivated the same dao.
Otherwise, no Master of Law would allow the others to cultivate their dao. Thus, he concluded that the process of dao fusion was also the process of growing the dao itself.

When numerous people cultivated the same dao, they shared the power of the dao. But at the same time, they were all growing and nurturing the dao together. And this would benefit the Master of Law. When needed, the master could simply drain all the power of the dao and all the other cultivators of the dao would be helpless against it.
The white dog said indifferently, “Sure. You can try.”
“In that case, I might need to take some people in here later.”
“Just make sure you don’t damage anything.”

The white dog did not mind. After giving it some thought, he pointed at a nearby hill with his paw and said, “Just take them there. Don’t enter the courtyard. I’m worried that they will make this place dirty!”
Su Yu smiled, “Sure. Don’t worry. By the way, there is another matter I wish to talk about, Senior…”
“Sure.”

Su Yu dragged a struggling furball out and said, “Can you get Senior Book Spirit to read him some books? He is cultivating wrongly. Or to be precise, he has no idea how he should cultivate his dao. Like a child, he’s not very bright…”

The little furball protested, “I have always been a child! Yummy, you have changed! After becoming strong, you start looking down on us! One by one, you’re leaving us behind! After leaving so many people behind, are you leaving me behind now?”
Su Yu blanked out.

The white dog blanked out as well. He even stopped wagging his tail. He could empathize deeply with this. He gave Su Yu a long stare before saying bleakly, “You…are more and more similar to Master. He walked the same path. Slowly, he grew strong. Slowly, he grew lonely. Numerous people were left behind. Little Master pursued him endlessly, but ultimately, even she was left behind…”
The white dog couldn’t help but recall Culture King. His mood turned melancholic.
True!

People like them would grow repeatedly, eventually reaching a point where the world was no longer the same in their eyes. The sky would change as well. They would yearn for the unknown. Slowly but surely, they drifted further and further away from their companions.

Culture King had left his old residence, his sister, the white dog, and Soy Bun behind. As he moved forward, more and more people were left behind. Until one fateful day, when he looked back…he found that he was already alone.

Su Yu frowned slightly, but he soon smiled and said, “No, that won’t happen. I am not Culture King. Also, Culture King left in search of Time Sage. Be good, Furball. Study hard and grow strong. Only by growing strong can you avoid the fate of being left behind. If you stop growing, I’ll have to start looking for your dada and mama instead.”
The little furball was greatly saddened. He didn’t want to study! That was torture! He was just a ball! Why must a ball study? He only needed to eat, eat, and eat to grow! Why must he study?

Having recovered from his melancholic mood, the white dog wagged his tail again and said, “Sure. I’ll have Book Spirit read to him. That big lump of wood has been studying recently as well! They can study together!”
Su Yu said, “In that case, I’ll be troubling you, Senior.”
Not far away, the book spirit gave Su Yu a slight bow before giving the little furball a wave and a smile.
The little furball sank into despair.
“Yummy, how long should I be good?”
Studying!
That was the biggest torture one could be subjected to!

Su Yu laughed and answered, “It won’t be long. Just study until you understand your dao. Otherwise, you will be stuck below the Eternal Realm forever. Work hard and aim to surpass your dada! Your race is blessed by the heavens! The three of you are the only dao incarnates in existence since the beginning of time! You are special!”
“Really?”
The little furball disagreed. Since Su Yu was stronger, and since dao incarnates were so strong, he believed that Su Yu was the real dao incarnate here.
“I’ll be taking my leave. I can’t keep the people outside waiting for too long.”

Su Yu looked at the white dog and said, “Allow me to thank you for my success in killing East Heavenly King. But gratitude alone means nothing. I can only promise that when I gain enough strength, I will look for Time Sage and Culture King.”
“Woof!”

The white dog barked and wagged his tail rapidly. Clearly, he was very happy to hear that. There was no need for Su Yu to thank him. The promise to look for his master and little master was enough. He was very happy to receive this promise.

Just as Su Yu stood up to leave, the white dog recalled something and asked curiously, “I can smell a strong scent of my master on you. I nearly mistook you for my master. Did you receive anything from his other residence?”
Su Yu nearly staggered.
After a short pause, he replied without meeting the white dog’s gaze, “I cleaned his office and replaced some of his old furniture for him.”
“Oh.”
The white dog said nothing else.

After Su Yu left, the white dog started carrying one thing after another from the courtyard into the house with his mouth. After a while, he stopped beside the stone table and hesitated. Should he put this table away as well?
Not far away, the little furball said, “Put it away as well. If you leave it here, Yummy will take it away one day.”
“Woof!”

Understood! The white dog lifted the stone table and chair with his mouth before leaving. Shortly after, he flew outside the residence and dug a large boulder out of the nearby hill before sculpting it into a new stone table and chair.
What a scary guy. The new human lord was a thief. That description of the human lord made the truth very clear. Thus, the white dog was terrified. He vowed to keep a closer look at this residence.
He couldn’t allow the new human lord to replace even the furniture here as well. It was fine for the furniture in the office to be replaced, but the same couldn’t happen to his master’s home!
Su Yu was naturally unaware of what the white dog was doing.
He was also unaware that the little furball had sold him out.
After stepping out of the waterfall, he saw numerous Invincibles. Some were seated in meditation, and some were conversing among themselves. Some opened their mouths to greet him.

Just then, Su Yu opened his Heaven Gate and swept his gaze through them. Instantly, all of them chilled. Even the seated Invincibles stood up uncontrollably. Great Zhou King, Great Qin King, and the others said nothing.

Great Qin King was staring at Su Yu with surprise. As for Su Yu, the Heaven Gate on his forehead faded away in mere moments. But its effect was still active as his pair of eyes had grown much sharper and brighter than before. Before long, he paused his gaze on Junior Zhou King.
Faced with his gaze, Junior Zhou King felt somewhat uncomfortable. He took a step forth and asked, “Do you have any instructions for us, Holy Lord?”

After a while, Su Yu said calmly, “You are doing very well. Your dao is not completely original, but it can be considered a unique path. You have a much higher chance of reaching Daofuse than the others here. In fact, you even have a chance to surpass the Daofuse Realm. Of course, the premise for that is the absence of a master at the end of the dao you pursued.”
Junior Zhou King’s heart shook violently. As for the others, they looked at both Su Yu and Junior Zhou King with a slight shock. What was this? They were mostly confused.

Su Yu continued, “There is no need for you to switch your dao. Slow your body cultivation and focus on the dao of time. No, to be precise, focus on the dao of speed. You need to understand that at its core, the dao you comprehended isn’t the dao of time. It is speed. A form of speed. An extreme form of speed. Your ability to speed up others involves an acceleration within a specific domain. It doesn’t have much to do with time itself.”
Junior Zhou King’s shock intensified.
Speed.
He was known as the Time King, famed for his ability to speed up the flow of time. But someone was telling him that his understanding was wrong. He was pursuing the dao of speed, not time.
The two were fundamentally different.
